articles.title: New DeFi entrant widens field of crypto political campaign funds as elections loom
articles.snippet: The Defend Developers PAC is aiming to contribute to lawmakers who seek to shield crypto developers from legal vulnerabilities.

articles.title: Bitcoin steadies at $67,000, faces critical juncture after sliding 9.5% in seven days
articles.snippet: The recovery does little to mask a 9.5% weekly decline as U.S. stocks hit records highs, AI tokens rally and Coinbase's Ethena deal steals the spotlight.

articles.title: Franklin Templeton says Wall Street fears blockchain because it threatens its profits
articles.snippet: Jenny Johnson, Franklin Templeton's CEO, said blockchain and crypto threaten a huge number of business models that exist today in traditional finance.

articles.title: UK Lords warn BoE could regulate pound stablecoins into irrelevance
articles.snippet: A UK House of Lords committee warned that strict stablecoin rules could make pound sterling tokens commercially unworkable despite supporting regulation.

articles.title: UK Regulator Warns Soccer Clubs Over Unauthorized Crypto Sponsorship Deals
articles.snippet: The FCA has warned Premier League clubs that partnerships with unlicensed crypto firms could expose fans to unregulated trading platforms.
